title: Request detail endpoint (GET /api/hooks/{id}/requests/{rid})
user_story: As a user, I need to inspect the full details of a captured webhook request — including headers and body — so I can debug integrations.
description: Implement GET /api/hooks/{id}/requests/{rid} to return the full detail of a single captured request. Includes all fields: request_id, hook_id, method, path, headers (as JSON object), body (base64-encoded for binary safety), content_length, source_ip, and received_at. A new database method get_request() fetches a single request by hook_id and request_id. Returns 404 if the hook or request doesn't exist. Body is returned as base64 string to safely handle binary payloads in JSON.

acceptance_criteria.given: a hook with a captured POST request containing JSON body and custom headers
acceptance_criteria.then: response is 200 with full request detail: request_id, hook_id, method, path, headers, body (base64), content_length, source_ip, received_at

acceptance_criteria.given: a hook exists but the request_id doesn't exist
acceptance_criteria.then: response is 404 with structured JSON error and suggestion
response is 404 with structured JSON error

acceptance_criteria.given: a captured request with binary (non-UTF-8) body
acceptance_criteria.then: the body field is base64-encoded and can be decoded back to the original bytes

acceptance_criteria.given: a captured request with an empty body
acceptance_criteria.then: the body field is an empty base64 string and content_length is 0

acceptance_criteria.given: a captured request with multiple headers
acceptance_criteria.then: all headers are present as a JSON object with string keys and string values
integration tests verify full detail, 404 cases, binary body base64, empty body, and header preservation

single_binary_checklist.notes: base64 crate is already a transitive dependency. Body stored as BLOB, encoded to base64 only in the response. Single-row lookup by primary key is O(1).
